recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic theatrical scene featuring a central figure in a dark suit bowing on a wooden stage, framed by heavy blue velvet curtains and a deep red backdrop, with bold, wide typography spanning the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the curtains and the central performer
Contrast between the cool blue curtains and the warm red backdrop
Vertical alignment of the performer's shadow with the stage floorboards
Horizontal dominance of the oversized title against the vertical stage elements
coreInvariants: Deep blue velvet curtains with white fringe
Central spotlighting creating a harsh shadow
Wide-set, blocky sans-serif typography at the top
A performer in a formal suit bowing forward

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The performer is centrally located, scaled to approximately one-third of the vertical height, positioned in the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white, wide-lettered title at the top acts as the primary anchor, followed by the performer's head in the spotlight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large text at the top, down the center line to the performer, then follows the spotlight down to the audience silhouettes at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark, shadowed areas in the curtains and the audience foreground to focus attention on the stage center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Royal Blue (curtains and stage floor)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with deep shadows and bright highlights; saturated primary colors against black silhouettes.

letterConstructionRules: Squared-off corners with slight rounding on outer edges
Mirroring or reversal of specific characters for stylistic effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: First character is a mirrored 'E' or a numeric '3' integrated into the word flow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone display type; no secondary fonts used.
graphicDevices: Ornate filigree flourish centered below the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, squared-off geometric aesthetic.
Similar horizontal emphasis and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A theatrical stage with dark wood floorboards, two stage lights in the foreground, and silhouettes of an audience at the bottom. Large blue velvet curtains are pulled back to reveal a performer in a dark suit and red tie bowing in a central spotlight against a deep red velvet backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of ultra-wide, bold, white geometric sans-serif text across the top. The first letter should be a mirrored 'E'. Add a small, thin ornate flourish centered directly below the text.

verificationChecks: Are the curtains deep blue with white fringe?
Is the performer bowing in a central spotlight?
Does the text span nearly the entire width of the top?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the performer
Any trademarked logos or specific branding
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the spotlight shadow aligns with the performer
Verify the typography is horizontally expanded
Confirm the presence of the audience silhouettes at the bottom edge
recipe.reuseFormula: Theatrical Stage + Wide Geometric Typography + Central Bowing Figure + Blue/Red/White Palette
